name: New Best Friend
body:
You make good use of scavenged equipment.

Prerequisite(s): Character level 3rd.

Benefit(s): You only take half the nonproficiency penalty for weapons or equipment that you are not proficient with. If a weapon or piece of equipment requires expertise or technology you have no exposure to, you can still use it, but must spend an hour practicing with it to reduce your nonproficiency penalty.

Special: You can take this feat twice. If you take it a second time, you take no penalties for nonproficiency, but still do not count as proficient for the purposes of feats or other abilities.
